sheets.title: Site Plan - Option 1
sheets.reading_notes: Preliminary conceptual Option 1 site plan. Shows existing CMSA yard with new 460' x 170' gravel expansion area to the east, separated from existing yard by proposed Level 2 Constructed Wetland BMP (~30,000 SF assumed). New extended detention basin (~20,000 SF) to north. Chain link fence with powered sliding gate/card reader. Existing compactors relocated. Shows existing site utilities: 8" PVC, 12" DI, SS lines, CRYO lines, power conduit. Existing woodland treeline marked. JLab campus 2 DOE parcels noted. Sheet 1 of 5. Scale 1:60 approx. Designed by WAF, checked by NCH. Oct 7, 2021. Not approved for construction.

sheets.title: Site Plan - Option 2
sheets.reading_notes: Preliminary conceptual Option 2. 460' x 170' gravel expansion contiguous with existing yard; BMP moved to east. Continuous paved surface. Extended detention basin (~20,000 SF) to north, Level 2 Constructed Wetland (~30,000 SF) to east/southeast. Compactors relocated. Future building and parking noted. Sheet 2 of 5.

sheets.title: Site Plan - Option 3
sheets.reading_notes: Preliminary conceptual Option 3. Larger expansion 460' x 170' area. Independent BMPs to north and south. Level 2 Constructed Wetland (~15,000 SF) and Extended Detention Basin (~10,000 SF). New drainage ditch (1,100' long) to SE required; wetland impact. Sheet 3 of 5.

sheets.title: Drainage Profile - Option 3 (1 of 2)
sheets.reading_notes: Drainage profile for Option 3 outfall ditch. Shows 0.57% slope (inadequate—would need 0.20% or less). Notes: at 0.20% slope, ditch prone to retaining water, requires increased excavation and wetland impacts. Key civil engineering challenge for Option 3. Sheet 4 of 5.

sheets.title: Drainage Profile - Option 3 (2 of 2)
sheets.reading_notes: Continuation of Option 3 drainage profile. Shows wetland area crossing. Sheet 5 of 5. VHB project 58665.00.

sheets.title: Existing Conditions Plan
sheets.reading_notes: Final conceptual existing conditions plan. Detailed existing site survey with spot elevations (VHB limited on-ground survey to verify JLab-provided compiled survey). Shows existing CMSA gravel laydown yard, buildings 32/34/52, utility corridors (SS, W, CRYO, ELEC, conduit), drainage structures with inverts, wetland area, woodland treeline. Notes: (1) existing conditions based on compiled survey from JLab; (2) horizontal/vertical control from JLab site control. JLab title in drawings is 'Jefferson Lab Central Material Storage Area.' Sheet 1 of 9. Nov 8, 2021.

sheets.title: Site Plan - Option 1
sheets.reading_notes: Final conceptual Option 1 site plan. Gravel yard expansion = 1.85 AC; approximate limits of disturbance = 3.52 AC. Expansion area 460' x 170'. New extended detention basin (~20,000 SF assumed), Level 2 Constructed Wetland (~30,000 SF assumed). Powered sliding gate with card reader. 250W LED light poles with radiation monitors (typical). Chain link fence (7' with barbed wire per report). Gravel surface: 9" stone over woven geotextile. Min 1.0% slope. Sheet 2 of 9. Nov 8, 2021.

sheets.title: Grading Profile - Option 1
sheets.reading_notes: Grading profile for Option 1. Shows existing grade of existing laydown yard, grading through extended detention basin, and laydown yard expansion with proposed grade. Min elevation within proposed yard = 34.00 per report. Sheet 3 of 9.

sheets.title: Site Plan - Option 2
sheets.reading_notes: Final conceptual Option 2 site plan. Gravel yard expansion = 2.00 AC; approximate limits of disturbance = 3.56 AC. Expansion 460' x 189'. Level 2 Constructed Wetland with Clay Liner (~30,000 SF) to east. Contiguous laydown surface. Sheet 4 of 9. Nov 8, 2021.

sheets.title: Grading Profile - Option 2
sheets.reading_notes: Grading profile for Option 2. Shows cut condition to east, minimum elevation ~31.5 at eastern edge. Clay liner required adjacent to wetlands. Sheet 5 of 9.

sheets.title: Site Plan - Option 3
sheets.reading_notes: Final conceptual Option 3 site plan. Gravel yard expansion = 2.80 AC; limits of disturbance = 5.23 AC. Expansion 460' x 265'. Independent BMPs north and south: Level 2 Constructed Wetland (~12,000 SF) north, Extended Detention Basin with Clay Liner (~10,000 SF) south. Grade break with drainage swale to southern BMP and trench drain. Sheet 6 of 9. Nov 8, 2021.

sheets.title: Grading Profile - Option 3 (1 of 3)
sheets.reading_notes: Option 3 grading profile section 1. Shows laydown yard expansion grade from existing yard through expansion area. Sheet 7 of 9.

sheets.title: Grading Profile - Option 3 (2 of 3)
sheets.reading_notes: Option 3 grading profile section 2. Outfall ditch profile at 0.30% slope. Crosses wetland area. Dual culverts with endwalls. Sheet 8 of 9.

sheets.title: Grading Profile - Option 3 (3 of 3)
sheets.reading_notes: Option 3 grading profile section 3. Continuation of outfall route to receiving ditch north of building 23. Profile at 0.18% slope. Sheet 9 of 9.

sheets.title: Site Plan Exhibit - Option 1
sheets.reading_notes: Presentation-quality exhibit of Option 1 with light pole spacing dimensions (100'-9" typical bay). Shows 250W LED lights with radiation monitors (typical). Sheet 2 of 39 exhibit set. Nov 8, 2021.

sheets.title: Site Plan Exhibit - Option 2
sheets.reading_notes: Presentation-quality exhibit of Option 2 with light pole spacing. Sheet 3 of 39 exhibit set.

sheets.title: Site Plan Exhibit - Option 3
sheets.reading_notes: Presentation-quality exhibit of Option 3. Sheet 6 of 39 in exhibit set context. Wetland area, extended detention basin with clay liner, and trench drain all shown. Storm pipe with endwalls. Limits of clearing noted.

conflict_flags.description: Expansion area differs across sources and options. GET geotechnical proposal states 78,200 SF as the expansion target; final conceptual design shows three options ranging from 80,586 SF (Option 1, 1.85 ac) to 121,968 SF (Option 3, 2.80 ac). The 78,200 SF is the early planning estimate; final design options bracket it.
conflict_flags.resolution_chosen: 78,200 SF as primary value per GET geotechnical proposal (original expansion target)
conflict_flags.rationale: The 78,200 SF is the earliest quantified design target; the three conceptual options bracket the final scope. No final design documents showing which option was selected are in the source set.

conflict_flags.description: BFA prime design fee to JLab not captured in any source document. Only subconsultant fees (VHB $87,196, GET $16,805.50) and BFA electrical cost estimates are available. Total prime fee is unknown.
